name: manual_a36cfa
claim: When multiple independent review voices (Codex + Claude subagents) disagree or one contains a verified-false claim, save every voice verbatim in its own file with inline [FALSE, see caveat] or [CORRECTION, ...] annotations rather than silently correcting, omitting, or only synthesizing a summary — preserves full auditability and lets a human see exactly which claims were checked and how.

decisions.notes: User explicit instruction 2026-07-12: 'save all the agent's Quad CEO review? i want to see them in parallel, compile them in a folder' for PR #205's 4-voice CEO review, which included one worktree-agent with a fully false central claim and one resumed-agent with a partially-corrected claim. Landed as docs/phase-0-specifications/2026-07-12-ceo-review-quad-voices/ (00-README.md index + 01-04 per-voice files).
